name: @artifact-site/cli
stderr:
Usage: artifact-site [options] [command]

Manage your remote Artifact Site library of pages, reports, charts and
documents: find previous work, read it, publish updates and share links.

Options:
  -v, --version                   print the CLI version
  --base <url>                    artifact-site base URL (or ARTIFACT_SITE_URL /
                                  the stored config)
  --tenant <id>                   destination tenant (or ARTIFACT_SITE_TENANT)
  --share-token <token>           share context (or ARTIFACT_SITE_SHARE_TOKEN)
  --json                          machine-readable output
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                 Sign in once on this machine (device
                                  authorisation in the browser); stores the
                                  publish token
  logout                          Forget the stored token for this server
  whoami                          Check the connected account and server;
                                  credentials are already stored after login
  publish [options] <path>        Publish a file (.html / pdf / pptx / docx /
                                  .zip), a directory, or HTML from stdin (`-`)
                                  as a new site
  update [options] <slug> [path]  Replace a remote artifact's full contents, or
                                  rename it with --title and no path
  official                        Manage the single official designation without
                                  changing latest contents
  edit [options] <slug> <path>    Replace one remote text file, preserving other
                                  files; read it first and supply its version
  fork <slug>                     Copy a remote artifact into a new independent
                                  artifact, leaving its source unchanged
  info [options] <slug>           Inspect a remote artifact: kind, current
                                  version, files and history; optionally sharing
                                  records
  find [options] [query...]       Show my remote artifacts; with keywords,
                                  search discoverable pages, reports and
                                  documents
  folders                         Organize the connected personal account's
                                  library; operator credentials have no personal
                                  folders
  move [options] <slug>           Move an owned or collaborative artifact into
                                  my folder; changes no content or sharing
  read [options] <slug>           Read a remote report/document for summarizing
                                  or reuse; --file reads one original text file
  comments                        Read feedback and exact context before
                                  updating the same artifact; never marks
                                  comments read
  share [options] <slug>          Create a share link for a site
  export [options] <slug>         Download the current version as a zip; prints
                                  the version id for --expected-version
  rollback <slug> <versionId>     Restore an earlier version as the current one
  delete <slug>                   Delete a site you own
  mcp                             Run a local MCP server over stdio that
                                  forwards to this server's /mcp with this CLI's
                                  credential
  skill                           Print the platform's publishing guide for
                                  agents (/for-agents.md)
  help [command]                  display help for command

Common tasks:
  artifact-site login --base https://your-server
  artifact-site find                              # my published artifacts
  artifact-site find quarterly report             # mixed results, labeled by relationship
  artifact-site find --public                     # explicitly browse the public catalog
  artifact-site folders list
